description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams for filtering employee event searches, including fields for employee number, date range, type, and event.

classes.name: EmployeeEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee events, extending the base FilterParams class.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getDateRange
methods.description: Returns the date range filter object.

methods.name: setDateRange
methods.description: Sets the date range filter object.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of employee event filter.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type filter for employee events.
